 Daily Bullets (Oct. 24): We’ll Cross Colorado’s Goal, and Then We’ll Sing “Oklahoma State”
 Thanks for stopping by – here’s your daily dose of Oklahoma State sports news. 
 Published
 12 hours ago on
 October 24, 2026 
 By
 Steven Mandeville 
 Share 
 Tweet 
 Thanks for stopping by – here’s your daily dose of Oklahoma State sports news. 
 Three Thoughts
 • All the pregame content – previewing the game with TV details , picks and predictions , and a roundtable chewing on the game (PFB)
 • CBS Sports gave Eric Morris and the Pokes a mid-term grade of a B+, which feels just right (CBS Sports) –
 • The Cowboys won a scrimmage against TU yesterday , good experience for a team forming – the Oklahoman did a piece on a benefactor that Steve Lutz gives a lot of credit to (PFB + NewsOK)
 Two Quotes
 • What affirmation – Eric Morris compares Drew Mestemaker to Patrick Mahomes .
 “Yeah, I think him and Patrick (Mahomes), their recall is phenomenal and their spatial awareness, and so I think those are two of the smartest quarterbacks that I’ve ever been with,” Morris said. “That (they) are able to take something from the meeting room, and they really diagnose it, and they’re able to put it in action right away…” [PFB] 
 • Some fun highlights:
 America’s Greatest Homecoming 🤠 https://t.co/CFvfGFNDoX
— OSU Cowboy Football (@CowboyFB) October 24, 2026 
 One Question
 • Can you think of a bigger celebrity coach to visit Stillwater than Deion Sanders?
